segments.text: 只剩三张兵力票，还能赢吗？这场据点争夺，最后真的险胜了。
english: Only three tickets left.
Could we still win?
This conquest match
ended in a very close victory.

segments.text: 这是虫潮围城的战地模式。旧镇、通信站、补给仓库，抢的就是这三个点。
english: This is the Battlefield mode in Swarm Siege.
Old Town, Comms Station and Supply Depot:
these are the three objectives.

segments.text: 控制两个点，就会持续扣掉对面的兵力票。光顾着追人，旗子被偷，照样会输。喜欢这个玩法，顺手点个赞。
english: Control two objectives
and the enemy keeps losing tickets.
Chase enemies while
your flags get taken,
and you can still lose.
If you like this mode,
leave a like.

segments.text: 这次没有买兵和升级。五种兵种用固定装备，开局我选工程兵，先开坦克推进。
english: There is no troop purchasing or leveling up here.
Five classes have fixed loadouts.
I choose Engineer at the start
and push forward in a tank.

segments.text: 这段是另开一局补拍的载具战。坦克沿着道路推进，挨打会掉装甲，步兵也在往旗点靠。
english: This vehicle footage is from a separate match.
The tank advances along the road.
Its armor drops when it takes hits.
Infantry are moving toward the objectives too.

segments.text: 回到主战局，第一波我就倒了。但不用一直从老家跑：选已经占住的仓库，换成医疗兵，再部署到前线。
english: Back in the main match,
I went down in the first push.
Select our captured depot instead of running from HQ,
switch to Medic,
and redeploy near the front.

segments.text: 残血的时候按支援，血量就能补回来。活着留在圈里，比冲出去再送一次更有用。
english: Use support when hurt
to recover health.
Staying alive inside the objective
helps more than rushing out and dying again.

segments.text: 中间的通信站反复易手。我贴着掩体交火，再扔手雷压住路口。对面也会开车和反扑，真不能一直硬冲。
english: The central Comms Station changes hands repeatedly.
I fight from cover
and throw a grenade toward the junction.
The enemy uses vehicles and counterattacks too.
I cannot just keep charging straight in.

segments.text: 到最后，两边兵力都见底了。我们守住通信站和仓库，对面票数归零，我方剩三票。
english: By the end,
both teams were almost out of tickets.
We held Comms Station and Supply Depot.
The enemy reached zero;
we had three left.

segments.text: 结算挺有意思：我方击杀九十四，对面一百零五。杀得更多的一边，反而输了。抢点和保住自己，都得算进去。
english: The result is interesting: our team scored 94 kills,
and theirs scored 105.
The team with more kills
still lost.
Objectives and staying alive
both matter.

segments.text: 这一局靠占点赢下来了，正面硬冲还是很容易倒。下次我想试试兵种配合和侧翼夺点。虫潮围城现在可以在百宝箱试玩，想玩什么也可以填愿望单。
english: We won this match through objective control,
but direct charges were still deadly.
Next time I want to try class teamwork and flanking.
You can now play 虫潮围城, Swarm Siege, on the Treasure Box website.
You can also submit a game idea to the wishlist.
